paragraphs: R' Hoshaya, his son; Vayikra Rabbah 31:9.[^1]

notes.text: ויק״ר פ״לא-ט is read as Vayikra Rabbah 31:9; earlier machine OCR had פ״לא״מ. This does not establish a printed variant, and no named edition is independently checked. Hoshaya is presented as Simlai’s son; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
